speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Cutaneous Larva Migrans (Hookworm infection).

The combination of intense itching, red burrowing tracks or bumps, recent travel to Miami (a tropical region), and the specific absence of a fluid-filled response to scratching strongly suggests a parasitic skin infection caused by hookworm larvae. Your blood work was normal, which rules out a severe systemic reaction or bacterial cellulitis. This is a common condition for travelers walking barefoot in sandy or soil areas.
